lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gills, arranged in approximately five primary horizontal rows with clear vertical alignment between nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated teal intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a rectilinear grid where the high-luminance blobs serve as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges on the upper third of the flank exhibit a sharp vertical gradient, with light-saturated upper edges and shadowed lower margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-frequency cluster of minute, high-luminance speckles is concentrated on the anterior snout and the proximal base of the pectoral fin.
